name: A Whole Lot to Love
source:
A Whole Lot to Love is a visual novel about dating plus sized girls 

Sam, a freshman college student, is eager to start working on figuring out what he wants to do for his career. Along the way, he encounters several girls who all have dreams of aspirations all their own. What kinds of things will they introduce Sam to?

[From [url=https://wholelottolovevn.itch.io/a-whole-lot-to-love]Itch.io[/url]]
